final_draft.answer: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.
final_draft.note: The answer uses the approved wording as written (owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-16). A live read-only check on 2026-11-16 at 17:03 UTC confirmed it. AWS account 111122223333 had all four S3 public access block settings turned on account-wide: block public ACLs, ignore public ACLs, block public policy and restrict public buckets. These sources only cover AWS account 111122223333. If the company has other AWS accounts or other object storage, they weren't checked.
